protocol.source: Local ST-MTM preprint, Section 5.2, PDF page 8
protocol.landmarks: Unweighted leaf-arc support centroids, aligned to exact leaf IDs
protocol.display_positions: Actual raster anchors, all methods on a fixed [0,1] full canvas per sequence
protocol.sns: Frame mean of min_alpha sum(d_ij-alpha*abs(x_i-x_j))^2 / sum(d_ij^2), no square root
protocol.sns_eligibility: n >= 2 and nonzero original pair distances; n >= 3 mean also reported
protocol.tw: Standard rank-penalized trustworthiness; k=1 primary for every dataset/method
protocol.tw_eligibility: 0 < k < n/2; k=3 and k=5 secondary, only on eligible frames
protocol.ties: Stable leaf-row order in both distance rankings; tied frames counted; no-tie sensitivity reported
protocol.td: SUM of absolute matched-anchor displacement over consecutive frames, not an average
protocol.td_units: Full-canvas widths (one fixed affine raster/canvas mapping per method/sequence); also common 2048-pixel units
protocol.td_caution: Measures stability, not correctness of motion; compare methods within each dataset
protocol.parameters: Existing main configurations unchanged: RG-MTM-R eligibility 0.2*scalar range; ST temporal settings retained
protocol.decision: No universal acceptance threshold; report wins/ties/losses against each baseline without a combined score
protocol.excluded: No runtime or publication-number replication claim; source preprint uses different preprocessing/resolution
